items.question: What fruit is granted by the door-deity besides removing untimely death?
premises: The door-deity grants all desired fruits.
The two benefits are stated together.
items.inference: The verse attributes both removal of untimely death and granting of all desired fruits to the door-deity.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case and referent are inferred from context; surface spelling is preserved.
items.plain_english: It removes untimely death and indeed grants the fruit of all desires.
